response.sql:
WITH station_averages AS (
  SELECT
    observstation,
    AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct
  FROM telescopes
)
SELECT
  s.observstation,
  s.avg_bandusagepct,
  s.avg_bandusagepct - o.avg_bandusagepct AS above_overall_avg
FROM station_averages AS s
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
WHERE s.avg_bandusagepct > o.avg_bandusagepct
ORDER BY above_overall_avg DESC
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Stations are included when they have at least one telescope; AVG ignores NULL bandwidth values, and stations whose bandwidth values are all NULL have no average and are excluded.
